finding.expected: Export the deterministic Termux service environment before invoking service-daemon (at minimum PREFIX, SVDIR, and LOGDIR; preserve HOME as needed), and strengthen the standard-library static contract test so a future non-exported environment regression fails. Keep the bootstrap one-shot and preserve all existing NODE-003B authority bounds.
finding.issue: The bootstrap assigns PREFIX, HOME, SVDIR, and LOGDIR as shell variables but does not export the service environment before exec'ing service-daemon. service-daemon is a new process and reads PREFIX and SVDIR from its process environment; in particular SVDIR is not guaranteed to be inherited from a Termux app-shell invocation. The current static test only checks assignment text, so it can pass while service-daemon receives no SVDIR and fails to supervise $PREFIX/var/service after cold boot.
